description.value: Deer Lake Gallery (DLG) is a contemporary art house operated by the Burnaby Arts Council within the cultural campus of Deer Lake Park, Burnaby. Founded to support emerging and established artists, it hosts 10–12 exhibitions per year featuring thought-provoking and experimental work from local and regional artists. Touring cyclists riding through Burnaby's scenic Deer Lake area will find a free cultural stop with rotating shows just steps from the park's trails.

address.value: 6584 Deer Lake Ave, Burnaby, BC V5G 3T7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The direct OSM URL (deer-lake-gallery-exhibitions/) returned a 404, but subpages of burnabyartscouncil.org confirm the gallery is real and active: the /about/ page describes it as hosting 10–12 exhibitions per year at Deer Lake Park in Burnaby, the /exhibitions/ page lists numerous recent and past shows, and the /contact/ page confirms address and phone. No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, water, etc.) appear anywhere in the website content. The OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but all website content and the address place this in Burnaby.
